issue.title: router: router.recognize(path) fails if path has query params

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Label used to distinguish feature request from other issues

issue.body:
It looks like if I try to use the `router.recognize(path)` when `path` is of `/login/;return_url=/account` shape, the path is not recognized.

It would makes sense that the path recongnizer would ignore the query params and look at the path instead, so it would look at `/login/` which will probably be recongnized assuming that there is a route matching that path.
